title: DevOps Architect
jobDescription: A CICD Architect is responsible for providing functional and/or technical expertise to plan, analyze, define, develop and delivery CI/CD capabilities for an application or group of applications w.r.t product/solutions. Assist in facilitating setting up environment, integration & automation of the entire deployment environment. The person is also responsible for hands-on problem-solving and ensuring Dev Sec Ops best practices and security by design. Defining Technical Strategy CICD Design & Environment Research on latest Technology Security & Compliance
